provenance.ramp_crosswalk_method: Explicit plaza-name/road/movement crosswalk to study groups; selected record direction and kind must match the published tariff code.
provenance.position_policy: All 34 markers are approximate browsing references. Ramp markers identify study interchanges. Barrier markers use authority camera mileposts; no individual booths are positioned.
provenance.rates_policy: Standard Class 1 Garden State Parkway fares do not change by time of day. Enrolled Senior and Green Pass plans have off-peak discounts. Discounts shown require NJ E-ZPass. Senior/Green Pass require enrollment and eligibility. Heavy trucks registered at least 10,000 lb with 6 tires or 3+ axles are prohibited north of interchange 105. Truck volume discounts and trailer plans are not applied.
provenance.counts_policy: 11 mainline and 23 ramp tariff entries; grouped schedule entries are not a count of individual physical plazas, booths or lanes. No booth inventory is claimed.

pricing.periods: Peak: weekdays 7–9 a.m. and 4:30–6:30 p.m.; all day Saturday and Sunday. All other times are off-peak. Eastern time.
pricing.standard_car_rule: Regular passenger-car fares stay the same throughout the day. Enrolled Senior and Green Pass users can receive off-peak discounts.
pricing.eligibility: The discounts shown require an eligible NJ E-ZPass account. Senior and Green Pass users must be enrolled. Heavy trucks cannot travel north of Exit 105. Trailer and truck-volume discounts are not included here.
pricing.source_method: Authoritative cash/NJ E-ZPass tables retained from prior release; off-peak and Senior/Green Pass tables inspected in full via public PDF reader on 2026-10-22; numeric cells cross-checked by plaza name and published milepost.
